name: Domain Language
version_note: Installed release 2.0.0-alpha2. VERIFIED FATAL on Drupal 11.4.4 as shipped: domain_language.services.yml passes ['@config.storage'] to DomainLanguageOverrider::__construct(), which expects (AccountProxyInterface, DomainNegotiatorInterface, ConfigFactoryInterface, OverriderInterface). Because it is a config.factory.override service it is built during container compilation, so enabling the module makes every request and drush command fatal with a TypeError. Documented from source; needs the argument list corrected before use.
